_comment: Domains whose reporting is credible enough to cite as web-search evidence. This is source SELECTION, not verdict determination: the design law keeps source risk about the publisher and never lets it make a claim false (app/verdict/engine.py rule 6). What this list does is decide which open-web pages are worth a reasoning call and a citation — a fact-checker does not cite a conspiracy blog as evidence, and neither should we. Registrable domains only (no www, no path). Government, education and international-organisation TLDs are trusted by pattern in credibility.py and need not be listed. Grow this list; it is data, not code.
